A desktop clock for working with teammates and clients across time zones. Drag the clock to any time and see every city follow: their local time, their date, who's working and who's asleep.

## Download

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| **Windows 10 / 11** (64-bit) | [`Longitude_{{VERSION}}_x64-setup.exe`](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/releases/download/{{TAG}}/Longitude_{{VERSION}}_x64-setup.exe) |
| **macOS 12+** (Apple Silicon and Intel), preview | [`Longitude_{{VERSION}}_universal.dmg`](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/releases/download/{{TAG}}/Longitude_{{VERSION}}_universal.dmg) |

## First launch

Longitude isn't code-signed yet, so your system will ask you to confirm the first time:

- **Windows:** if "Windows protected your PC" appears, click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **macOS:** open the app once, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.

Full steps, updating and uninstalling: [installation guide](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/blob/{{TAG}}/docs/INSTALL.md) · New to Longitude? Read the [user guide](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/blob/{{TAG}}/docs/USER_GUIDE.md).

See the [changelog](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/blob/{{TAG}}/CHANGELOG.md).

## Good to know

- No account, no telemetry and no internet connection needed. Everything stays on your computer.
- The Mac build is a **preview**: it passes automated tests but hasn't been checked on real Mac hardware yet. Please [report problems](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/issues/new/choose).
- Verify your download with `SHA256SUMS.txt` below.
- Longitude is free. If it helps you, you can [buy me a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/longitude) ☕
